Are you a strong leadership profile who can translate strategy into action plans, then you have the chance to become the Managing Director of Form & Frys.

Drive strategy, performance, and operational excellence across the organization

As Managing Director of Form & Frys, you will have full P&L responsibility and overall accountability for the strategic, commercial, operational, and organizational development of the company. Reporting to the Board of Directors of Rademaker, you will lead the business into its next phase of development, with a clear mandate to drive profitable growth, strengthen performance, and build a more scalable organization.

You will own the financial performance of the business, including revenue, profitability, budgeting, forecasting, and delivery against agreed targets and KPIs. Working closely with the leadership team, you will translate strategy into clear priorities and strengthen structures, processes, and leadership capabilities across sales, engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, finance, and people.

Commercially, you will strengthen relationships with key customers and strategic accounts while identifying new opportunities for growth. At the same time, you will work closely with Rademaker to leverage the capabilities and international reach of the wider organization, balancing Form & Frys’ entrepreneurial mindset, technical expertise, and customer proximity with the structure and strategic direction required for continued profitable growth.

Adept leader with technical abilities and a strong commercial mindset

The ideal candidate brings solid senior leadership experience from an international industrial or manufacturing environment, ideally within machinery, automation, food processing equipment, or another engineering-driven business. You have held full P&L responsibility and combine strong commercial acumen with a sound understanding of operations, technology, and financial management that enables you to make informed decisions that drive the company’s performance. Likewise, you have extensive experience in managing high-level, global stakeholders, paired with strong technical expertise.

You have a proven track record of developing and professionalizing organizations, translating strategy into execution, and driving profitable growth. Experience working with a parent company or professional Board is an advantage, as is exposure to international B2B markets.

You are a commercially minded and engaging leader who combines strategic perspective with a pragmatic, hands-on approach. You create direction, structure, and accountability while empowering the organization and leadership team to take ownership and deliver results. Entrepreneurial and decisive by nature, you are comfortable operating close to customers, employees, and the business while maintaining a broader strategic perspective. You build strong relationships across the organization and balance the need for greater structure and professionalization with the agility and entrepreneurial mindset that characterize Form & Frys. Furthermore, you are required to possess strong interpersonal and communication skills, as you will be collaborating across various functions and levels within the organization. Finally, fluency in both Danish and English is required, and you should be prepared to travel as necessary to meet the demands of this role.

Set and execute the strategic direction at Form & Frys

This is a unique opportunity to become part of a global organization, where management and professionalism are of the highest standards within the food processing industry. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search (www.venaris.dk). For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Sr. Executive Search Consultant Lars Nordlund on +45 3123 3018. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV - it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

Form & Frys Maskinteknik

Form & Frys is a Danish engineering company specializing in the development and manufacture of advanced machinery for the international bakery industry. Based in Hobro, Denmark, the company provides specialized solutions for forming, folding, and filling dough-based products, including Danish and puff pastry, pizza, pies, and savoury products. Combining strong technical expertise, application know-how, and close customer collaboration, Form & Frys delivers both standardized machinery and customized solutions tailored to specific production requirements. Since 2025, Form & Frys has been part of Rademaker, strengthening the company’s international reach and creating a strong platform for continued development and growth. Learn more about this here: https://www.formfrys.dk/

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Product Marketing Manager

__

What we believe in:

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges head-on. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are important drivers in our goal to enable everyone to create sustainable solutions. This is our story. Make it your story.

Role and tasks

As Associate Project Manager, you will take responsibility for smaller projects from planning through delivery and close-out. You will coordinate customers, colleagues, suppliers and other stakeholders to keep projects moving according to scope, schedule, quality and financial targets.

The role gives you direct responsibility for the full project process while working closely with experienced colleagues across sales, engineering, procurement and operations. Your responsibilities will include

• Plan, coordinate and follow up on projects, ensuring activities and milestones progress according to the agreed scope and schedule.

• Act as a key contact for customers and coordinate across internal teams, suppliers and other project stakeholders.

• Monitor project financials, including costs, invoicing, cash flow and resource utilization.

• Identify and follow up on project risks, opportunities and changes, escalating when needed and taking corrective action together with the relevant stakeholders.

• Coordinate procurement of services, materials and equipment and support dialogue with suppliers throughout project execution.

• Maintain project schedules, track progress and promptly address potential delays that could affect on-time delivery.

• Ensure required project documentation, contractual obligations, quality requirements and HSE standards are followed.

• Support project acceptance and close-out and capture relevant lessons learned for future projects.

Qualifications for the role

• 
A relevant technical or commercial education combined with an interest in project management and project execution.

• 
Some experience with project management, project coordination or similar work. We also welcome candidates who are still building their project management experience.

• 
Ability to plan and coordinate activities and follow them through together with colleagues, customers and suppliers.

• 
An understanding of basic project economics, schedules and risk management, or an interest in developing these skills.

• 
Comfortable communicating with different stakeholders and keeping relevant people informed when priorities, deadlines or project conditions change.

• 
Comfortable working in English.

At ABB, we have a clear goal of promoting diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, LGBTQ+, disability, ethnicity, and age. Together, we have embarked on a journey where we all individually and collectively celebrate and welcome individual differences. You can look forward to joining an organization that emphasizes employee well-being. Collaboration and team spirit are key words for us and a crucial foundation for reaching our shared goals. We prioritize a good working environment highly and continuously invest in the education and development of you and your colleagues. If you want to read more about our continuous work with the working environment and sustainability, you can find more information at: https://global.abb/group/en/sustainability

You will be based at our office in Middelfart, alongside your closest colleagues. In addition, we offer the possibility of working from home a few days a week.

The position reports to Product Marketing Director Morten Hellesøe.

Apply for the job online via our simple and easily accessible system, where you can also sign up to receive notifications on other opportunities within ABB. If you have questions about the position before then, you are welcome to contact Morten Hellesøe at +4540278387.

The application deadline is 10.12.2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

_Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Software Engineer, Reporting & Fee Management 📈

You will help build the products our customers use to communicate investment results and charge their clients.

Reporting and fee management look simple from the outside, but every wealth manager has its own data, calculations, presentation requirements, commercial agreements, and operating processes. Joining Performativ should not require customers to abandon what makes their business work.

Our direction is to turn these differences into flexible, reusable platform capabilities. This includes a new reporting workbench and AI-assisted experiences that allow users to configure, generate, and publish reports and fee arrangements safely themselves.

• You will build reporting and fee-management capabilities that turn complex portfolio data and customer requirements into accurate, understandable outputs.

• You will work closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to understand real workflows, challenge assumptions, and distinguish reusable product needs from one-off requests.

• You will help develop self-service configuration and AI-assisted workflows, with clear validation, permissions, review steps, and safeguards for untrusted input.

• You will investigate issues across data, calculations, configuration, and presentation, then deliver permanent solutions that are observable, testable, and safe to deploy.

• You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their decisions and output critically, and leave systems in a state that teammates can understand and extend.

You should bring solid software-engineering judgment and an interest in developing product and financial-domain understanding. Experience with investment reporting, fee calculations, portfolio data, document generation, configurable workflows, or financial software would be valuable, but deep experience with our exact technology stack is not required.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be able to recognise incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, weak product decisions, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• The opportunity to build products used directly by wealth managers and their clients.

• Difficult product and engineering problems involving financial data, calculations, configuration, document generation, and AI-assisted workflows.

• A central role in making complex reporting and fee management genuinely self-service.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows.

💰Salary based on your experience and seniority level: 🇩🇰Up to 48,000 DKK (gross)

**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

jobs.occupation: Research Assistant in Explainable and Causality Informed Reinforcement Learning (DEIS)
jobs.description:
We invite applications for a full-time, one-year position as Research Assistant in the Section of Distributed, Embedded and Intelligent Systems (DEIS), Department of Computer Science, Aalborg University. The position focuses on developing reinforcement learning methods that produce understandable control strategies and provide insight into the underlying system dynamics and causal relationships. The research will address safe and effective control of cyber-physical systems, with particular emphasis on UPPAAL Stratego and collaboration with domain experts and external partners.

Expected starting date: 01.12.2026.

Your work tasks

You will develop and evaluate methods for explainable and causality informed reinforcement learning. The aim is to make learned strategies transparent to human domain experts, support well-founded trust in their decisions, and improve understanding of hidden dynamics and causal relationships in the systems being controlled. Your tasks will include:

• Developing compact, interpretable representations of learned control strategies, including strategy minimisation with guaranteed preservation of safety properties.

• Investigating how causal information can inform reinforcement learning and help explain the behaviour and decisions of learned strategies.

• Working with reinforcement learning and recurrent neural networks in UPPAAL Stratego, including implementation and experimental evaluation.

• Applying and evaluating the methods on safety-critical cyber-physical systems, with relevant case studies in water and wastewater infrastructure.

• Collaborating with DEIS researchers, the UPPAAL development team and external partners, and contributing to scientific publications and dissemination.

The work builds on DEIS research in safe reinforcement learning and practical experience with UPPAAL Stratego for modelling and optimal control of wastewater infrastructure, including collaboration with HOFOR continuing the DIREC Bridge project Verifiable and Safe AI.

Your competencies

You should have a strong background in reinforcement learning and machine learning, solid programming skills, and experience implementing and evaluating research methods. Knowledge of explainable AI, causal reasoning, recurrent neural networks, or interpretable policy representations is particularly relevant. Experience with UPPAAL or UPPAAL Stratego, formal verification, and modelling and control of cyber-physical systems is an advantage. You should be able to work independently, collaborate with researchers and domain experts, and communicate research clearly in English.

Qualification requirements

Appointment as a research assistant requires academic qualifications at master’s degree level. A relevant degree in computer science or a closely related discipline is expected.

Who we are

You will join Section DEIS at the Department of Computer Science, Aalborg University. The position brings together research in formal methods, machine learning and cyber-physical systems, with opportunities to contribute to the UPPAAL tool suite and its applications.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• An application stating your reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position.

• Curriculum Vitae (CV).

• Diplomas.

• A list of publications. You may attach a maximum of five publications (optional).

• Documentation of teaching qualifications, following the relevant faculty guidelines for teaching portfolios.

• Dissemination qualifications, including participation in committees, boards or organisations.

• Additional qualifications relevant to the position.

• References or recommendations.

Please consult Aalborg University’s application requirements for further guidance.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University’s website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions

For questions about the position, please contact Professor Kim Guldstrand Larsen, kgl@cs.aau.dk, telephone +45 22 17 11 59.

Further information

Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Research assistant”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Photonic Integrated Circuits for Next-Generation LiDAR - DTU Electro
jobs.description:
Help turn advanced photonic chip designs into advanced 3D sensing technology.

Are you interested in integrated photonics, optical sensing, and chip design? Join NiteLiDAR, an EU-funded Doctoral Network, and develop integrated LiDAR technology through a PhD spanning simulation, chip design, nanofabrication and experimental demonstration.

You will be working at DTU Electro, in the Photonic Integrated Circuit based Systems (PICSys) group. The setting will be the cutting-edge laboratory for photonic integrated devices and advanced optical systems, and the access to one of the largest cleanroom facilities in European Universities. You will be working with a group of professionals in photonic integrated devices, optical phased array, LiDAR, optical communications, optical computing, and FPGA hardware programming. 

You will join an international team of 10 PhD researchers working on photonic and electronic integrated circuits for next-generation LiDAR. The network brings together three universities, an international R&D organization, and a company, with partners across four EU countries. Your project includes one year of research at IMEC, giving you the opportunity to work across academic and industrial research environments.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your goal will be to design and experimentally investigate a photonic integrated chip for LiDAR, with a focus on frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) ranging and optical phased array (OPA) beam steering.

You will follow the development process from defining system requirements to measuring chip performance and reconstructing 3D scenes. Your work will include:

• Exploring system architectures: Define specifications, review state-of-the-art approaches, and identify promising on-chip implementations.
• Assessing system performance: Calculate optical link budgets in collaboration with another doctoral researcher.
• Modelling photonic components: Simulate key building blocks, including OPAs and grating couplers, on silicon nitride (SiN) and silicon-on-insulator (SOI) platforms.
• Designing a LiDAR chip: Develop the chip design and layout in close collaboration with researchers across the network.
• Nanofabrication of LiDAR chips using DTU Nanolab cleanroom. 
• Demonstrating sensing capabilities: Characterize the OPA’s far-field performance, conduct ranging experiments, and reconstruct 3D point clouds from measured data.
• Supervise BSc and MSc student projects.
• Data analysis, writing of scientific articles and presentations at conferences and meetings.
• Participate in outreach activities including, but not limited to, social media updates, participation in public events and campaigns, as well as dissemination to popular press.
We welcome applicants with a background in photonics, electrical engineering, applied physics, or a closely related discipline, and a strong interest in connecting theoretical concepts with practical experiments.

Experience in optical modelling, numerical simulation, cleanroom fabrication, photonic integrated circuits, or experimental optics would be valuable. Curiosity, self-motivation, analytical thinking, and enthusiasm for collaborating in an international research team are central to this project. Excellent English communication skills both spoken and written. Candidates with a strong background in integrated photonics, silicon photonics, or nanophotonics are preferred. 

Due to the mobility rules of the Marie Skłodowska-Curie program, you must not have resided or carried out your main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before the recruitment date.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be made by Senior Researcher Hao Hu at DTU Electro and Marcus Dahlem at IMEC.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. 

The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is 1 February 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Dr. Hao Hu, huhao@dtu.dk. 

You can read more about DTU Electro at www.electro.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 20 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A mandatory research statement discussing your comprehension or achievements in photonic integrated circuits for LiDAR, including an analysis of the opportunities, challenges, obstacles, etc. You are more than welcome to include your research results and justify how the results could contribute to this research field, if any. Maximum 2 pages.
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

The recruitment is taking place following the European Code of Conduct for Recruitment of Researchers, which all candidates are encouraged to study.

Selection process
To ensure a gender balance in the project and work towards the Commission’s own policies on narrowing the gap between the genders in research, should two applicants be found to be equally qualified the preference will be given to the one that will balance the gender distribution in the entire Network. After the deadline, all submitted applications will be checked against the defined admissibility and eligibility criteria (e.g. submitted electronically, readable, complete, in English, including grades and references), and applicants will be informed by email within two work weeks on the outcome. The following interviews and selection process will be carried out by a temporary Selection Committee constituted by the Coordinator (when possible) and the supervisors. Evaluation criteria include: Scientific background, capacity for creativity and independent thinking and leadership, mentoring and presentation abilities.

Protection of personal data: The personal data of the applicants will be handled in compliance with applicable EU and national law on data protection (GDPR). 

DTU Electro 
DTU Electro employs more than 300 skilled researchers with competencies in electrical and photonics engineering. As a department, we strive towards creating sustainable energy and a greener internet, as well as strengthening cyber security and health technology. Working with industry and public organizations is one of our top priorities to find and implement new solutions to our society. We aim to offer education, research, and innovation of the highest standard, and our focus on application-oriented research enables us to work across many engineering disciplines and research areas, such as IT and the medical and health sciences. We have a close collaboration with researchers from all over the world, just as we collaborate with industry and public authorities about the dissemination of solutions based on electrical and photonics engineering as their key enabling technologies. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Transformational Change Manager | Financial Services | Copenhagen, Denmark

Are you ready to lead teams and drive impactful change at scale for financial services clients? Are you passionate about helping organizations successfully navigate transformation, and do you bring both strategic vision and hands-on delivery experience? Then the role of Transformational Change Manager in Copenhagen is your next career move. Let’s build the future of work—together.

About the Team and the Role

As a Manager within our Talent team, based in Copenhagen, Denmark, you will take ownership of end-to-end project delivery, client relationships, and account management, with financial services as your primary industry focus. You will guide teams in co-creating and implementing human-centered transformation strategies, develop change approaches that are agile and ready for the digital world, and ensure the realization of measurable business outcomes.

You will work primarily with leading financial services clients, including banks, insurance providers, and capital markets firms, partnering with them on digital, technology-driven, and organizational transformations. You will be part of multidisciplinary teams delivering large, complex programs, working closely with client teams and international colleagues to solve challenging organizational problems, lead key workstreams, guide junior colleagues, and deliver specific project outcomes. Explore our point of view and Talent offering here.

The Work

• Lead Transformation Journeys – Help financial services clients navigate complex transformations, building organizations that are more capable, resilient, and adaptable to redirection and ambiguity.

• Human-Centered Change Strategies – Translate strategic direction and business objectives into holistic, agile change strategies that address culture, ways of working, and readiness for the future.

• Deep Change Management Expertise – Drive leadership alignment to the change vision, activate change using insight-driven approaches leveraging AI, engage large-scale change networks, and prepare organizations for business readiness, technology adoption, and new ways of working.

• Workforce Reinvention – Shape organization design, reskilling, and upskilling strategies for new operating models (e.g., S/4HANA, GBS, human-agentic workforce) and prepare the workforce for emerging roles.

• Technology Enablement – Unlock the human potential of new technologies through enterprise-wide system implementations, digital learning platforms, and AI-enabled change activation.

• Data-Driven Insights – Use analytics and predictive tools to measure adoption, sentiment, and transformation impact.

• Stakeholder Engagement & Account Management – Build trusted relationships with C-level executives and client teams in financial services, oversee account health, and proactively identify opportunities to expand our footprint.

• Business Development – Build trusted client relationships, identifying new growth opportunities, supporting business development activities, and shaping go-to-market strategies.

You will also:

• Lead workstreams and coach junior colleagues, bringing together cross-functional teams and specialists.

• Collaborate with Financial Services clients, the Netherlands & Nordics Talent practice and Accenture’s international network of experts.

• Balance changing priorities and timelines while keeping delivery focused on practical, measurable outcomes.

• Contribute to an inclusive, supportive team culture and continue developing your expertise in Change & Transformation Management.

About You

You bring a background in management consulting, organizational change or business transformation, with experience delivering people-centered change in complex, technology-enabled programs. You understand the opportunities and challenges facing banks, insurers and capital markets firms as they modernize systems, redesign operating models and introduce new ways of working. Your project experience may include roles such as Change Manager, Transformation Lead, Organizational Change Lead, Change and Communications Lead or Business Project Manager.

You are passionate about the people side of transformation and about turning strategic ambitions into meaningful, measurable change. You can align leaders around a shared vision, engage stakeholders and change networks, and shape communication, training and adoption activities that help people embrace new technologies, processes and behaviors. You use data and feedback to assess readiness, measure adoption and improve your approach iteratively.

You are comfortable leading workstreams and multidisciplinary teams in fast-paced, complex environments, combining strategic thinking with hands-on delivery. You build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, coach junior colleagues and solve problems in a people-oriented, insight-driven way. Most importantly, you are a collaborative colleague who helps teams navigate uncertainty and achieve outcomes together.

Requirements

• 
5+ years of relevant experience in organizational change, future workforce and/ or Human Resources; for example, guiding organizations in their transformation journey, designing and implementing large-scale communication and training programs, or upskill leaders to carry out desired behaviors.

• 
Management consulting experience or experience working within Financial Services, is a plus, not a prerequisite

• 
Strong consulting skills and the ability to engage senior business and HR stakeholders

• 
Strong self-leadership, with experience leading workstreams, collaborating in teams and coaching junior colleagues

• 
Understanding of organizational change and transformation components and complexicty, preferably within financial services and knowledge of banking, insurance, or capital markets transformation challenges

• 
A commercial mindset, the ability to build trusted client networks and a focus on measurable business and workforce outcomes

• 
Experience collaborating with cross-functional project teams in a global environment

• 
Professional proficiency in English; Danish language skills is an advantage for local client engagement, but not a requirement

• 
Track record as people-oriented, insight driven and iterative problem solver

• 
A master’s degree in a relevant field, such as business, engineering, or behavioral and social sciences

What We Offer

• Membership in our growing Netherlands & Nordics Talent team, with access to a global network of experts at the forefront of talent reinvention

• The opportunity to shape your career around your aspirations, with regular support from your People Lead

• A competitive salary, bonus schemes, health insurance, an employee share purchase program, and other benefits

• A strong commitment to employee well-being and work-life balance, including flexible arrangements that support family life, mental health, and well-being

• A supportive, encouraging and fun team who always roots for one another

• Market-leading expertise, a steep learning curve and great opportunities for development

• Opportunities to participate in corporate citizenship initiatives, including volunteering, charity work, and Inclusion & Diversity networks

Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for an opportunity where you can make an impact, shape decisions, and accelerate your career?

If so, we are looking for dedicated, curious, and highly motivated graduates to join the DFDS Graduate Programme starting in September 2027.

**Be part of the movement - and play your part

**About The Role The DFDS Graduate Programme is a two-year fast-track programme for recent graduates with an interest in and passion for the maritime industry.

During the programme, you will complete three rotations across different areas of our Ferry Division. You will begin at our headquarters in Copenhagen, followed by a mandatory international rotation at one of our European hubs. Your final rotation at our headquarters will be tailored to your skills, interests, and our business needs.

Throughout the programme, you will gain broad exposure to both the operational and commercial sides of our Ferry Division while building valuable industry knowledge and professional experience.

Ferry Operations offers broad end-to-end exposure with sustainability, standardisation, and digitalisation at the heart of everything we do.

**Examples Of Interesting Tasks Could Be To:

**

• Help design and develop the vessels of tomorrow, supporting our green transition through electrification, ammonia, and green methanol initiatives.

• Support the operation and maintenance of our fleet of more than 70 RoRo, RoPax, and passenger vessels, covering everything from dry dock planning to crisis management and contingency handling.

• Contribute to our standardisation and digitalisation journey across eight owned terminals and more than 20 third-party terminals, where safety remains our highest priority.

• Support fleet planning, equipment optimisation, and our intercontinental rail setup, connecting ferry and logistics operations across our network.

In the commercial part of our Ferry Division, you will work alongside colleagues across Europe, supporting both B2B and B2C markets.

**Examples Of Interesting Tasks Could Be To:

**

• Support local and global sales teams and assist with key account management, ensuring our network is successfully marketed and sold across regions.

• Drive continuous improvement in customer service and booking processes through standardisation and digitalisation initiatives.

• Collaborate with IT teams to enhance and optimise our digital customer offerings.

• Work with operational teams to optimise routes and vessel capacity to meet customer demand.

• Support revenue management activities, including pricing optimisation and commercial performance analysis.

Across all rotations, you will work closely with highly skilled colleagues and engage with customers, suppliers, and partners throughout the maritime value chain. To support your development, each rotation will include both a dedicated manager and a mentor who will help you successfully navigate your learning journey.

Alongside hands-on experience at DFDS, you will participate in the Danish Shipping Education Programme, delivered by Danish Shipping. This programme consists of webinars, four seminars in Denmark, and one international seminar, covering key topics across the maritime industry.

****About You

****At DFDS, we believe the strongest teams are built on diversity, inclusion, and different perspectives. We are looking for candidates who:

• Have graduated from a relevant master’s degree by the start of the Graduate Programme in September 2027, preferably within maritime studies, supply chain, freight forwarding, logistics, sustainability, business, finance, engineering, or a related field.

• Have gained relevant experience through a student job, internship, exchange programme, or other extracurricular activities.

• Have no more than two years of full-time professional experience after completing your master's degree.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Are collaborative team players who enjoy working with others and creating impact.

• Are curious, proactive, and eager to learn and develop professionally.

• Have an international mindset and are excited about working across cultures and locations.

Working at DFDS **Join the movement and grow with us

**As part of the DFDS Graduate Programme, you will become part of a strong graduate network across the company and build valuable connections across our international business. We offer a steep learning curve, meaningful responsibility from day one, and three interesting rotations designed to accelerate your professional development.

Are we a match? Apply now.  If your skills, experience, aspirations, and personality match this opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Please Apply By Uploading Your CV no Later Than 30 November 2026. When Applying, You’re Also Asked To Answer The Following Questions:

• Why are you interested in joining the DFDS Graduate Programme?

• How will the programme help kickstart your career?

• How do you expect to contribute to the programme and DFDS?

• What do you believe will be your biggest challenge(s) during the programme?

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**Visit our Graduate site here to learn more and meet some of our people.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

**The Opportunity

**Veo processes thousands of hours of sports video daily, powering AI analysis for teams from grassroots to professional levels. The infrastructure you build will directly enable coaches and athletes worldwide to analyze, train, and compete better.

We're building KickOff, our next-generation GitOps platform. You'll join during a pivotal moment: we're actively migrating services to KickOff, establishing new platform patterns and enabling 100+ engineers to ship faster and more reliably. We also maintain separate on-premises Kubernetes clusters running model training and video processing workloads.

This isn't a "keep the lights on" role. You'll shape platform architecture, drive technical decisions, and directly impact engineering velocity across both cloud and on-prem environments.

**What You Will Do

**You'll join the platform engineering team that owns these areas together. We share ownership, pair on complex work, and rotate responsibilities.

• Evolve KickOff (our GitOps platform) to improve developer experience.

• Support service migrations to KickOff, partnering with product teams.

• Maintain and optimize KickOff on AWS EKS.

• Manage our on-premises Kubernetes clusters running ML training workloads.

• Establish monitoring, alerting, and observability using LGTM.

• Debug distributed systems spanning multiple environments.

• Create documentation and tooling that makes infrastructure approachable

As the platform matures, you'll have opportunities to shape multi-cluster architecture, GPU workload scheduling, disaster recovery strategy, and cloud provider independence.

**What You Could Bring

**We're looking for someone with 3-5 years running production infrastructure, including:

• Production Kubernetes: You've operated K8s in production and understand the operational reality, not just tutorials.

• Platform-as-product mindset: You've built internal tooling that real teams use, gathered feedback, and measured impact on productivity.

• Infrastructure as Code: Strong Terraform, Crossplane, or similar experience.

• Observability: You've implemented monitoring and alerting that helps teams operate confidently.

• Security awareness: You know how to embed security into platform design without slowing teams down.

• Problem-solving: You debug complex distributed systems and design practical solutions.

• Collaboration: You work through discussion and feedback, share context effectively.

Nice to have: GitOps tools (Flux, ArgoCD), Cilium, multi-cloud architecture, on-prem K8s experience.

**How We Work

**You’ll join a Copenhagen-based platform team of 5 engineers with shared ownership of KickOff and our on-prem Kubernetes clusters. We work closely together day to day through pairing, code reviews, and a rotating ownership model for operational responsibilities and platform improvements.

You’ll collaborate regularly with the Processing Platform team on workload needs, reliability, and developer experience, and you’ll use feedback from product and engineering teams to shape platform priorities and improve how teams build and ship on KickOff.

We work pragmatically and iterate quickly. We document decisions, favor simple solutions where possible, and focus on tooling and platform patterns that help teams move faster with confidence.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

**The position

**The Head of Regulatory Affairs & Compliance is responsible for leading the day-to-day central Regulatory Affairs & Compliance function, with primary responsibility for Omnigame’s B2C operator regulatory framework and for coordinating consistent regulatory standards, methodologies and governance across the wider business.

The role reports to the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer, who retains executive-level legal and regulatory strategy, overall oversight and escalation of material regulatory risk, Board-level reporting, significant legal interpretation, contractual/legal matters and major regulatory or enforcement matters.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and coordinate the central operational regulatory affairs and compliance framework, while supporting consistent regulatory standards and governance across Omnigame’s B2C and B2B activities.

• Lead and coordinate Omnigame’s central regulatory licensing portfolio and support the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer and relevant business owners with applications, renewals, variations, notifications and ongoing licence obligations.

• Act as a principal operational point of contact, together with the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer, for gambling regulators and coordinate regulatory correspondence, inspections, enquiries and submissions, escalating material matters to the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer.

• Assist with regulatory assessments for entry into new jurisdictions and ensure that market-entry requirements are identified, allocated and implemented.

• Own the regulatory reporting framework, including reporting calendars, quality assurance, submission governance and evidence of compliance.

• Lead regulatory change management: monitor developments, assess applicability and impact, allocate implementation actions, track remediation and ensure appropriate evidence and governance.

• Set or coordinate group-level compliance standards relevant to B2B counterparty due diligence where required and provide support or challenge on material matters.

• Coordinate cross-company regulatory standards for game, product and platform compliance and support material or cross-functional regulatory matters.

• Develop, maintain and improve compliance policies, procedures, controls, registers and monitoring arrangements.

• Identify material regulatory risks and control gaps, establish remediation plans and provide appropriate escalation and reporting to the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer.

• Coordinate and oversee regulatory audits, assurance activities, inspections and responses to regulator information requests with assistance from relevant Regulatory Affairs Specialist.

• Partner with Product, Technology, Commercial, Operations, AML and Safer Gambling to embed regulatory requirements into business processes and change initiatives.

• Lead, allocate and quality-assure the work of direct Regulatory Affairs & Compliance team members and support their professional development.

• Promote clear ownership, consistent working methods and effective knowledge-sharing between the central Regulatory Affairs & Compliance function and embedded compliance resources.

• Prepare management information and regulatory/compliance reporting for the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer and other relevant governance forums.

• Support the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer in implementing the wider legal and compliance strategy and in material regulatory projects.

**Qualifications And Experience

**

• A relevant higher education degree within law, business law, compliance, governance, risk management or a comparable field.

• Significant experience in regulatory affairs or compliance within online gambling or another highly regulated industry, including experience operating at senior specialist, manager or head-of-function level.

• Strong understanding of gambling licensing, regulatory reporting, regulatory change management and operational compliance frameworks.

• Experience leading or coordinating multi-jurisdictional regulatory projects and regulator interactions.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical controls, processes and business decisions.

• Experience managing, mentoring or coordinating compliance professionals and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Strong judgement, organization and communication skills, including the ability to identify matters requiring executive escalation.

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written; additional language skills are an advantage.
